Cc: security@ascendiohealth.com, oliver.cheng@ascendiohealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: preserve session traces for forensics window (SIG/CAIQ evidence)

Hi Marissa —

We have an active investigation on ASC-1972 and our security team needs a short preservation window for session traces and related ephemeral artifacts from the period 2026-07-28 through 2026-08-02. Can Redwood preserve the relevant session-level logs and KV-cache snapshots for that time range while we complete the analysis?

We also need a bundled evidence pack suitable for SIG/CAIQ review: a short statement describing how Redwood isolates preserved traces, sample export of a sanitized trace (redacted PHI), and timestamps/retention controls applied.

Can you confirm scope, expected timeline to produce the evidence, and any constraints (cost, export format)? We can share the ticket and a minimal list of tenant IDs privately.

Thanks — Lina
Lina Torres
Security Program Manager
Ascendio Health

Hi Lina —

Thanks for the heads-up and the ticket. We can scope a targeted preservation hold for the tenant IDs you provide and generate the SIG/CAIQ-oriented evidence items you listed. A couple quick clarifying items so we can give an exact ETA: 

- Confirm the tenant list (tenant IDs or account names) you want preserved.
- Confirm whether you need immutable snapshots (cold export) or a retention flag that prevents deletion for X days.
- Do you require redacted samples at PII/PHI level or a schema-only sample?

Typical turnaround: 3–5 business days to produce the evidence pack for a scoped preservation (assuming tenant list + signed request). If you need immediate short-term preservation while we await approvals, we can set a 14-day temporary hold and then extend it if needed with email authorization.

I’ll loop in Ben for cost/contract impacts and Jordan for any operations handoff.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Manager, Security Compliance 
Redwood Inference

Oliver / Lina —

Thanks — received the tenant IDs and the signed authorization (please retain the signed PDF for your records). We’ll proceed as follows: 

1) Immediate 14-day preservation hold applied to asc-00123 and asc-00456 by EOD today (no deletions allowed).
2) Prepare evidence pack (SIG/CAIQ friendly) containing: preservation checklist (short statement + timestamps), redacted sample export (schema + timestamps, PHI redacted), retention-flag snapshot (JSON export), and chain-of-custody memo.
3) Target ETA: 4 business days to deliver the pack to your security mailbox (security@ascendiohealth.com). If you confirm 30-day window instead of 14, we will apply the 30-day hold now and note it in the memo.

Costs: Ben and I discussed and there will be no charge for the first scoped preservation hold under standard support for accounts in our current plan. Extended exports or egress (bulk download of raw traces) would incur operational fees — we’ll confirm if that becomes necessary.

Next steps: Please confirm whether we should treat this as 14 or 30 days (we’ll apply 14 days by default), and we’ll send the evidence pack link when ready.

Cheers,
